name: vimbrowser-cli
systemHint: You can control the user's vimbrowser browser through the `vimbrowser-cli` CLI tool (source at ~/Workspace/exocortex/external-tools/vimbrowser-cli). Run `vimbrowser-cli -h` for usage reference. Use `vimbrowser-cli upload-file <tabid> <unique-css-selector|index:N> <absolute-path> [more paths...]` for existing file inputs. For a custom Browse button or File System Access picker, use `activate:SELECTOR`; Chromium trusted-activates that exact visible element and supplies the chooser atomically without showing a native modal. Target `chooser` remains available for a manual one-shot arm followed by a user click; inspect it with `upload-file-status` and cancel stale arms with `upload-file-cancel`. Do not try to read local files from page JavaScript. Bash tool timeout values are milliseconds: use 30000 for 30 seconds, not 30.
